title: Crusty Plugs
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Commander

Quest Type: Talk

Quest Description: Take Javier's used earplugs to the Townston Commander.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Commander

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: More with the Noise Complaints.

Zone: Balzack's Burrow

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Take Javier's used earplugs to the Townston Commander.

Offer:

Now that the terrible music has stopped I might be able to concentrate on brewing up another pot of coffee. I borrowed these earplugs from the Townston Commander a few years ago, and because of your valiant efforts I do not think I will need them anymore. Take them back to the Townston Commander for me would you?

Turn-in:

What is that smell, oh it's you...

Have you been drinking that terrible coffee Javier sells again? No? Oh goodness what is that? Earplugs.. they are crusty, I don't want them anymore that is disgusting. Well maybe I will be able to find a use for them after all. Thank you Dungeon Runner.

Client level range: 57–100
